title: AI Catalyst Founder Toolkit
description: A structured founder workflow toolkit for moving from raw idea to validation-ready plan.

modules.title: Pressure-Test Your Idea
modules.objective: Work out whether an idea is worth pursuing, before over-investing in it.

modules.title: Target Customer
modules.objective: Define exactly who you are building for, what they urgently need, how to recognise when they are ready to buy, and who should not be included.
outputs: Validation status and one-week validation plan

modules.title: Problem & Five Whys
modules.objective: Drive the beachhead customer's surface complaint down to a structural root cause, and turn it into five interview questions the Founder can take to real customers.

modules.title: Solution statement, features & benefits
modules.objective: Turn locked beachhead, problem, and confirmed interview evidence into a North Star solution statement and three Minimum Loveable features.
outputs: Feature Benefit Map (top 3 Minimum Loveable features)

modules.title: Epics & user stories
modules.objective: Turn Module 4 Minimum Loveable features into epics, INVEST user stories with acceptance criteria, and a scored MLP backlog.
founderInputs: Module 4 North Star and Feature Benefit Map
outputs: Scored sprint backlog with MLP line

modules.title: Competitive analysis & differentiation
modules.objective: Pressure-test the competitive landscape, feature comparison, moat, positioning, and why-now / why-us claims against live alternatives.
founderInputs: Module 4 North Star and Feature Benefit Map
outputs: Competitive landscape (with comparison matrix and positioning map)
Defensible position (moat, why now, why us)

modules.title: Business model & revenue architecture
modules.objective: Turn locked customer, solution, and competitive context into a path to first dollar, pricing, and a 90-day cash plan.
founderInputs: Module 4 North Star and Feature Benefit Map
Budget, weekly time, month-1 and month-6 goals
